answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake before trading, like a falcon allowed to perch on only one jetty: one bond, one seat. Spawning a thousand fakes then means locking a thousand bonds, and proven misbehavior slashes the bond, so an attacker trying to cross the canyon of false identities pays real capital per clone and forfeits it when caught, while honest agents simply reclaim theirs.
